# Agenda 0.10.3
- Pinch the trackpad to zoom the whole board out, so more of it fits on screen. It zooms in steps from today's size down to 40%, and everything shrinks together like an optical zoom. ⌘− and ⌘= also zoom, and ⌘0 or the small percentage badge in the corner resets to 100%. Each Mac remembers its zoom. - Fixes a Pulse note (such as an overdue deadline) drawing on top of a todo's deadline clock.

# Agenda 0.10.2
- Finishing a task that has two or more sub-tasks now gets a small celebration at its checkbox, scaled to how many sub-tasks it had, plus a note of the count. - Days on which you finished such tasks get tiny marks above their dot in the progress bar (more marks for bigger tasks), and hovering the day lists them first. - Nothing about how tasks are counted has changed.

# Agenda 0.10.1
- Delivers the optional effort points setting (Settings → Effort points) to anyone who installed an early copy of 0.10.0 that was missing it. Your points stay on, and switching them off never deletes points you've set.
Everything else in this release is described in the 0.10.0 notes: https://github.com/willschulz/agenda-releases/releases/tag/v0.10.0
